name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders that shimmer in sync, then blur the real content into place without a layout jump.

useCases: Cards, lists, and profile headers that wait on data, where the placeholder should match the final layout and hand over to the content without a jump.
limitations: The shimmer runs on the Web Animations API and is lined up by page position, measured when placeholders mount or resize; a placeholder that moves without resizing keeps its old alignment. A wrapper without a fallback covers its children with one block, so the children need a size while loading.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Wrap content in Skeleton with loading, and pass fallback for a custom placeholder layout. The wrapper sets aria-busy and announces loadingLabel. Reduced motion removes the shimmer and pulse and swaps to the content instantly.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/skeleton.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
